name: medqa_s96_baseline
responses: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.
My main symptom is Respiratory distress. I also have Tachypnea, Subcostal and intercostal retractions, Nasal flaring, Cyanosis.
Past medical history: The mother had gestational diabetes. No other significant family or prenatal history. Social history: Not applicable
The cyanosis improves with oxygen administration. No feeding difficulties were noted prior to onset of symptoms.
